how_to_read.step: index of the last executed cell in the four-neighbour route at that point
how_to_read.node_count/edge_count: RCG size after sampling and pruning, before goal selection
how_to_read.why.group: which Algorithm 1 rule fired: fixed order left -> up -> down -> right, then 'retreat' (dead end), then 'exhausted' (no open node and no retreat)
how_to_read.why.options: sorted open candidates in that group; the seeded RNG picks one
how_to_read.why.chosen: goal node selected in that group
how_to_read.state_update: Algorithm 2 result: current closed/kept open, vertical neighbours, link nodes inserted
how_to_read.holes: coverage-hole node set detected by the flood fill (Algorithm 3 input)
how_to_read.tsp: Algorithm 3 event: end case (1 goal / 2 start / 3 free end), NN and 2-opt lengths, order
how_to_read.retreat_used: True when Algorithm 1 escaped a dead end through a retreat node
how_to_read.move: executed mode (sweep/retreat/tsp) and the number of unit cells appended
how_to_read.nodes/edges: full RCG snapshot for this iteration (x, y, state, kind, reason) and edge list
